relationships: Every order item embeds a matching catalog SKU, name, and unit amount.
Order totals equal the sum of embedded line quantities and unit amounts.
Webhook samples refer to orders through metadata except deliberate missing-reference cases.
intentional_edge_cases: Repeated event IDs model delivery retries.
Some completed sessions are unpaid or have an amount, currency, or metadata mismatch.
The order store contains pending, already-paid, and cancelled terminal states.
